axes.yDefinition: log10 comoving number density of AGN per dex of L_bol, dPhi/dlogL_bol

representation.equation: dPhi/dlogL = phi*/[(L/L*)^g1 + (L/L*)^g2]; log L* = (log L*)0 + kL1 xi + kL2 xi^2 + kL3 xi^3, g1 = g10 10^(kg1 xi), g2 = 2 g20/[10^(kb1 xi)+10^(kb2 xi)] (>=1.3), xi = log10((1+z)/3)

selection.warning: Global fit of the bolometric QLF to the compilation of observed QLFs in optical, soft and hard X-ray, mid-IR and emission-line bands converted with the paper's SED, bolometric corrections and column-density distribution; domain is the luminosity window 43-48 over which the curve was checked, redshift range is that of the compiled data (Table of fits at z: 0.1-6.0); the paper forces gamma_2 >= 1.3.

definitions.bolometricCorrection: band-dependent luminosity-dependent corrections from the paper's intrinsic SED model (hard X-ray 2-10 keV: $(10.83,\,0.28,\,  6.08,\,-0.020)$ for $L_{2-10\,{\rm keV}}$)
definitions.obscurationCorrection: intrinsic (obscuration-corrected) luminosities: 'AGN with {\em intrinsic} (obscuration-corrected)'; column-density distribution of Ueda+03 including Compton-thick objects ('include an equal fraction of Compton-thick objects')
definitions.luminosityUnitNote: L_* is tabulated in L_sun = 3.9e33 erg/s (luminosity $L_{\sun}\equiv3.9\times10^{33}\,{\rm erg\,s^{-1}}$.); the expression takes x = log10 L_bol in erg/s

provenance.citation: Hopkins, Richards & Hernquist 2007, ApJ 654, 731 (arXiv:astro-ph/0605678), 'Best-Fit QLF to all Redshifts' table, row 'Full'; evolving double power law (Eq. of Sec. 'Analytic Fits as a Function of Redshift')
provenance.figure: table 'Best-Fit QLF to all Redshifts', row Full
provenance.extractionMethod: parameters transcribed from the arXiv LaTeX source; expression verified by script (rho_BH(z=0) quotes, vector curves of Shen+20 figures bol_1_0..bol_6_0)

intrinsic1.text: sources. Our compilation instead attempts to represent all

comptonthick.text: include an equal fraction of Compton-thick objects

records.notes: Observational constraint (analytic evolution in z). The luminosity must be in erg/s; L* of the paper is in L_sun = 3.9e33 erg/s.

representation.equation: dPhi/dlogL = phi*/[(L/L*)^g1 + (L/L*)^g2]; g1 = a0 T0 + a1 T1 + a2 T2 of (1+z) (Chebyshev), g2 = 2 b0/[(r)^b1+(r)^b2], log L* = 2 c0/[(r)^c1+(r)^c2], log phi* = d0+d1 (1+z), r=(1+z)/3

selection.warning: Global fit to the compiled multi-band QLFs (IR, B band, UV, soft and hard X-ray) converted onto the bolometric plane; constrained by data at 0<z<7 (constrained by observational data at $0<z<7$); the paper extrapolates beyond z=7 as a single power law, which this expression does not do. Domain is the luminosity window 43-48 over which the curve was checked.

definitions.bolometricCorrection: The bolometric luminosity is defined as the integrated luminosity from $30\micron$ to $500\keV$ (band corrections of the paper's quasar SED model)
definitions.obscurationCorrection: the QLFs presented include both the obscured and unobscured AGN (N_H distribution of Ueda+14 incl. Compton-thick, dust-to-gas ratio scaling with gas-phase metallicity)
definitions.luminosityUnitNote: L_* is in L_sun (axis label of the paper's break-luminosity figure, Lbreak.png); L_sun = 3.9e33 erg/s is not stated in the text and was fixed by the paper's own curves (max|diff| 0.0007-0.0074 dex at z=1-6 against 0.014-0.020 for 3.846e33 or 3.826e33)
